verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework, so per-call personalization is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence documents injecting dynamic variables or per-caller context at call or session start. The Cloud public API only "starts agent sessions" with no stated payload. The telephony docs describe inbound-call webhooks without per-caller data. Flows functions calling external APIs are an adjacent building block, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inject dynamic variables and per-caller context at call time so each conversation is personalized
